faq.q: How does the Geo-Location Punch In / Punch Out feature work?
faq.a: AdoTeam uses high-precision device GPS and Wi-Fi perimeter triangulation. Company administrators define authorized geographical boundaries (e.g. 50-meter radius around an office, warehouse, or client site). When employees tap 'Punch In' on their mobile app, the system instantly verifies their physical presence inside the perimeter. For field sales, dynamic client check-ins with geolocation tagging are also supported.

faq.q: Can AdoTeam integrate with our existing Biometric Fingerprint or Face Recognition hardware?
faq.a: Yes. Our cloud attendance engine includes pre-built APIs and real-time middleware for leading biometric hardware (e.g., eSSL, ZKTeco, Matrix, Realtime). Punches from biometric devices sync instantly alongside mobile app punches in a single consolidated attendance ledger.

faq.q: How does the automated Payroll and Salary Slip engine handle statutory deductions?
faq.a: The payroll module automatically computes Basic, HRA, Conveyance, Special Allowances, Employee & Employer PF (Provident Fund), ESI, Professional Tax (PT state-specific slabs), and income tax TDS deductions based on the employee's tax regime (Old vs New). Employees receive encrypted, password-protected digital salary slips that can be viewed or downloaded in PDF format instantly.

faq.q: What is the Attendance Regularization workflow?
faq.a: If an employee forgets to clock out, experiences hardware connectivity issues, or travels on official outdoor duty (OD), they can submit a regularization request through their self-service dashboard with a justification and optional attachments. Their reporting manager receives an instant notification to approve or reject with 1 click, automatically correcting the payroll attendance records.

faq.q: How long does it take to deploy and migrate from our existing Excel sheets or legacy software?
faq.a: Most enterprises with 50 to 5,000 employees go live within 3 to 7 business days. Our dedicated customer success team provides 1-click bulk Excel/CSV import templates for employee master data, past leave balances, salary structures, and department trees.

faq.q: Is our company employee and salary data secure and compliant?
faq.a: Absolutely. AdoTeam features enterprise-grade 256-bit AES encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and audit log tracking. We comply with Indian Data Protection standards and global security best practices.
